# polaris_catalog_role_assignment (Resource)

Manage one Polaris role assignment. Other assignments remain independently owned.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "polaris_catalog_role_assignment" "binding" {
  catalog        = "warehouse"
  catalog_role   = "iam_analysts"
  principal_role = "analysts"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `catalog` (String) Existing Polaris catalog name.
- `catalog_role` (String) Existing Polaris catalog_role name.
- `principal_role` (String) Existing Polaris principal_role name.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import polaris_catalog_role_assignment.binding '["warehouse","analysts","iam_analysts"]'
```
